items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, gated-product exposure, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate expansion, advertising, and alert expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves evidenced consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, data provenance and rights, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep private launch gates unchanged, keep external outreach unsent, and authorize only existing bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: upstream rights are unproven; compliance is a technical baseline only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown, including open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings; fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results; accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level rights and provenance, permitted caching/display/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table, including deletion, correction, access, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; capture deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdiction treatment without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; produce a read-only log-field, retention, access, vendor/DPA, incident, and data-request inventory.

Compliance, data quality, analytics, site, and revenue evidence does not support a clean fleet launch clearance. Compliance records 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Data quality is green overall but analytics and revenue attribution are yellow; failing sources must not be treated as zero. Analytics is configured for 39 sites, with known GSC permission errors and unconfigured sites. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate row is not site-attributable. Parked or unreachable sites require a concrete retain-parked or bounded-launch decision and completed site-specific checklist before exposure or monetization. Ordinary growth may continue only where site-specific consent, disclosures, claims, provenance, and platform boundaries are evidenced.

Candidate proposal review: decline the fleet execution control-plane capability for this cycle. Its operational evidence is credible, but introducing new control-plane scope is unsupported while 47 failure follow-ups remain open, 28 improvements await measurement, approved-proposal execution is 34% with 187 approved items unexecuted, security and operations evidence is incomplete, and cost records conflict. Preserve the concept only as an uncommitted future idea; create no proposal, queue entry, telemetry, dependency, spend, deployment, or requeue.
